title: FidelityProgress
description: Per-screen FIDELITY self-report. The self-check booleans mirror the dimensions the GATE legs assert, so a screen cannot be marked done while a leg that is already in force would fail it. A screen marked done with any of the required booleans false (or missing) is a lying exit.

irPresent.description: Layout IR exists for this screen (write-screen precondition).

absoluteBoxes.description: Geometry is placed at absolute IR bounds, not re-derived from flow.

iconSlotsRendered.description: Every non-live IR icon slot has a DOM element (gate-icon box pairing).

iconSlotsSymboled.description: No slot is still symbol.source=unresolved (gate-icon GATE_ICON_UNRESOLVED).

fluidMarked.description: Pages: block containers carry data-ir-fluid and follow the main area (gate-layout). Modals may record false.

cellsDrawn.description: Every non-sample IR cells[] box is drawn with its IR box and paint (gate-cells); true also when the IR declares no cells (same convention as iconSlotsSymboled on an icon-free screen). A screen that paints calendar/grid chrome must verify this — an unasserted rectangle is exactly the shape that degrades while pixel/geom/text/icon legs all pass.

liveDataWired.description: Live regions are marked and backfilled from the API (gate-data).

cardSizeLocked.description: Modals: the white card box matches the IR modal-card bounds (gate-geom).
